Scope lists only compact.py active-only default + flag; no scheduler/cron config artifact is named as changed or verified.
No AC covers the 'no events stranded unfolded' correctness claim; ACs cover visited counts, reverted-archive, usage/docs, lint only.
findings.finding: The plan asserts that a just-archived ticket's final fold 'still happens via the scheduled sweep run with --include-archived (documented), so no events are ever stranded unfolded' — but no scope item establishes or configures that scheduled --include-archived sweep, and no acceptance criterion verifies that archived-but-unfolded tickets actually get folded once compact-all defaults to active-only.
scenarios: A ticket is archived while it still has events not yet folded to SNAPSHOT; the default compact-all now skips it; the promised scheduled --include-archived run does not exist or is not configured, leaving events permanently unfolded.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a scope line + AC: e.g. 'a ticket archived with unfolded events is folded on the next --include-archived sweep' with a test that archives a ticket mid-events, runs compact-all --include-archived, and asserts the SNAPSHOT now covers those events; and cite the scheduler/cron entry that runs it.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the 'archived ticket was already folded on its way out' rationale with the fact that `leaf.archive` does not fold inline, and specify a mechanism that guarantees a just-archived ticket is folded exactly once (e.g. fold-on-archive inline, or make the scheduled sweep's --include-archived non-optional / self-healing) rather than relying on operators remembering the flag.
evidence: leaf.py:173-174 appends ARCHIVED event + write_marker with no compaction — archive does not fold
compact_all_cli is described as the store's 'only standing trigger' (compact.py:484-486); if it defaults active-only, archived tickets are never folded absent the flag
Plan claim: 'so no events are ever stranded unfolded' depends on operator running the scheduled sweep WITH --include-archived, which the plan does not make robust
findings.finding: The plan's mechanism guarantee 'no events are ever stranded unfolded' rests on a rationale that is factually wrong and on an unforced operator assumption: `leaf.archive` (src/rebar/_commands/leaf.py:142) writes only an ARCHIVED event + `.archived` marker and does NOT fold inline, so an archived ticket is NOT 'already folded on its way out' — the only fold is compact-all. Once compact-all defaults to active-only, a just-archived ticket is skipped, and its events are folded only if the SCHEDULED sweep carries `--include-archived`. The plan states this must happen ('documented') but nothing forces the scheduled invocation to pass the flag; a plain scheduled `compact-all` (the new default) strands the just-archived events unfolded indefinitely.
findings.location: Approach — 'an archived ticket was already folded and health-checked on its way out' / 'a final fold ... still happens via the scheduled sweep run with --include-archived'
scenarios: A ticket is archived; the scheduled compact-all runs without --include-archived; the ticket's ARCHIVED (and any pre-archive) events never get folded to a SNAPSHOT and grow the walk that --include-archived must later traverse

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State how a just-archived ticket's final fold is guaranteed without a CI/scheduled sweep — either fold synchronously in `rebar archive` (operation-linked trigger) or provide an in-process fallback — rather than relying on a scheduled sweep run that no-CI venues never fire.
evidence: Plan quote: 'a final fold for a just-archived ticket still happens via the scheduled sweep run with --include-archived (documented), so no events are ever stranded unfolded'
Plan quote: default compact-all becomes active-only ('compact_all_cli default active-only'), so a just-archived ticket is skipped by the default sweep
Portability matrix cell: 'projects with NO CI provider at all' — the scheduled sweep has no runner to fire it
findings.finding: The plan's correctness claim that 'no events are ever stranded unfolded' depends on 'the scheduled sweep run with --include-archived' folding just-archived tickets — but default compact-all now skips archived tickets, and a scheduled sweep is not guaranteed on all supported venues. If the final fold does not happen at `rebar archive` time and relies solely on a scheduled sweep, a project with no CI/scheduler never runs that sweep and the events remain unfolded.
findings.location: Approach — 'a final fold for a just-archived ticket still happens via the scheduled sweep run with --include-archived (documented), so no events are ever stranded unfolded'
scenarios: No-CI venue: a developer runs `rebar archive` on a ticket that was not fully folded, then never runs a scheduled sweep (no cron/CI exists); default compact-all skips the archived ticket, so its trailing events are never folded to a SNAPSHOT — the events stay stranded unfolded, contradicting the plan's stated invariant.
findings.suggested_fix: Have `rebar archive` perform the final fold synchronously as part of the archive operation (operation-linked trigger), so correctness does not depend on any later scheduled sweep; keep the --include-archived sweep as an optional deep re-audit only.
